SELECT CASE 
WHEN is_first_dev_job = 0 THEN 'No' 
WHEN is_first_dev_job = 1 THEN 'Yes' 
ELSE 'No Answer'
END AS first_time_developer, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE CASE WHEN is_software_dev = 0 THEN 'Aspiring Developer' WHEN is_software_dev = 1 THEN 'Currently A Developer' END = 'Currently A Developer' GROUP BY CASE 
WHEN is_first_dev_job = 0 THEN 'No' 
WHEN is_first_dev_job = 1 THEN 'Yes' 
ELSE 'No Answer'
END ORDER BY count DESC 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT country_live AS country_live, COUNT(*) AS count, count(country_live) AS "COUNT(country_live)" 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 1 GROUP BY country_live 
 LIMIT 10000

SELECT school_degree AS school_degree, COUNT(*) AS count, count(school_degree) AS "COUNT(school_degree)" 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 0 GROUP BY school_degree ORDER BY count DESC 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT CASE 
WHEN job_relocate = 0 THEN 'No: Not Willing to' 
WHEN job_relocate = 1 THEN 'Yes: Willing To'
ELSE 'No Answer'
END AS willing_to_relocate, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 0 GROUP BY CASE 
WHEN job_relocate = 0 THEN 'No: Not Willing to' 
WHEN job_relocate = 1 THEN 'Yes: Willing To'
ELSE 'No Answer'
END ORDER BY count DESC 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT country_citizen AS country_citizen, COUNT(*) AS count, count(country_live) AS "COUNT(country_live)" 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" GROUP BY country_citizen 
 LIMIT 50000

SELECT case 
when job_lctn_pref is Null then 'No Answer' 
when job_lctn_pref = 'from home' then 'From Home'
when job_lctn_pref = 'no preference' then 'No Preference'
when job_lctn_pref = 'in an office with other developers' then 'In an Office (with Other Developers)'
else job_lctn_pref
end  AS job_location_preference, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 0 GROUP BY case 
when job_lctn_pref is Null then 'No Answer' 
when job_lctn_pref = 'from home' then 'From Home'
when job_lctn_pref = 'no preference' then 'No Preference'
when job_lctn_pref = 'in an office with other developers' then 'In an Office (with Other Developers)'
else job_lctn_pref
end  ORDER BY count DESC 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT CASE 
WHEN is_ethnic_minority = 0 THEN 'No, not an ethnic minority' 
WHEN is_ethnic_minority = 1 THEN 'Yes, an ethnic minority' 
ELSE 'No Answer'
END AS ethnic_minority, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" GROUP BY CASE 
WHEN is_ethnic_minority = 0 THEN 'No, not an ethnic minority' 
WHEN is_ethnic_minority = 1 THEN 'Yes, an ethnic minority' 
ELSE 'No Answer'
END ORDER BY count DESC 
 LIMIT 10000;

SELECT time_start AS time_start, school_degree AS school_degree, sum(last_yr_income) AS "SUM(last_yr_income)" 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 1 AND last_yr_income <= 200000 GROUP BY time_start, school_degree 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT job_pref AS job_pref, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 0 AND job_pref != 'NULL' GROUP BY job_pref 
 LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 0 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT job_pref AS job_pref, school_degree AS school_degree, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 0 AND school_degree != 'NULL' AND job_pref != 'NULL' GROUP BY job_pref, school_degree ORDER BY job_pref ASC, school_degree ASC 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT last_yr_income AS last_yr_income 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE CASE WHEN is_software_dev = 0 THEN 'Aspiring Developer' WHEN is_software_dev = 1 THEN 'Currently A Developer' END = 'Currently A Developer' AND last_yr_income <= 100000 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT count(is_software_dev) AS "COUNT(is_software_dev)" 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE CASE WHEN is_software_dev = 0 THEN 'Aspiring Developer' WHEN is_software_dev = 1 THEN 'Currently A Developer' END = 'Currently A Developer' 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT CASE 
WHEN is_first_dev_job = 0 THEN 'No' 
WHEN is_first_dev_job = 1 THEN 'Yes' 
ELSE 'No Answer'
END AS first_time_developer, communite_time AS communite_time, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 1 AND CASE 
WHEN is_first_dev_job = 0 THEN 'No' 
WHEN is_first_dev_job = 1 THEN 'Yes' 
ELSE 'No Answer'
END != 'NULL' AND communite_time != 'NULL' GROUP BY CASE 
WHEN is_first_dev_job = 0 THEN 'No' 
WHEN is_first_dev_job = 1 THEN 'Yes' 
ELSE 'No Answer'
END, communite_time 
 LIMIT 10000;

SELECT lang_at_home AS lang_at_home, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE lang_at_home != 'NULL' GROUP BY lang_at_home ORDER BY count DESC 
 LIMIT 15;

SELECT expected_earn AS expected_earn 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE CASE WHEN is_software_dev = 0 THEN 'Aspiring Developer' WHEN is_software_dev = 1 THEN 'Currently A Developer' END = 'Aspiring Developer' AND expected_earn <= 200000 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT CASE 
WHEN is_ethnic_minority = 0 THEN 'No, not an ethnic minority' 
WHEN is_ethnic_minority = 1 THEN 'Yes, an ethnic minority' 
ELSE 'No Answer'
END AS ethnic_minority, gender AS gender, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE CASE 
WHEN is_ethnic_minority = 0 THEN 'No, not an ethnic minority' 
WHEN is_ethnic_minority = 1 THEN 'Yes, an ethnic minority' 
ELSE 'No Answer'
END != 'NULL' AND gender != 'NULL' GROUP BY CASE 
WHEN is_ethnic_minority = 0 THEN 'No, not an ethnic minority' 
WHEN is_ethnic_minority = 1 THEN 'Yes, an ethnic minority' 
ELSE 'No Answer'
END, gender 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT communite_time AS communite_time, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE CASE WHEN is_software_dev = 0 THEN 'Aspiring Developer' WHEN is_software_dev = 1 THEN 'Currently A Developer' END = 'Currently A Developer' AND communite_time != 'NULL' GROUP BY communite_time 
 LIMIT 50000;

 LIMIT 1000
